_help: News sources. "sources" is used in live mode, "demoSources" (fictional, local fixtures) in demo mode.
The 100 live sources were each verified on 2026-09-30 (docs/FUNDS-AE-BUILD-GUIDE.md Part C3). Re-check any time with: npm run check-sources -- --config
To ADD a source follow Part C6 of the guide (or the /add-source command in Claude Code). To REMOVE one set "enabled": false (keeps its history).
tier: L1 official/regulator, L2 press-release wire, L3 publisher RSS, L4 licensed API, L5 paid syndication.

licenseStatus: public_sector | wire | terms_reviewed | permission_granted | pending_review | blocked. Use pending_review until you have read the publisher's terms; terms_reviewed needs termsUrl and termsReviewedAt (YYYY-MM-DD); blocked sources must be disabled.

allowExcerpt: show the publisher's feed excerpt (true) or headline + link only (false). allowImages: show images from the publisher's own feed, hot-linked, only once its terms allow it (default false).

region: "uae" nudges ambiguous stories towards the UAE category; "global" does not. focus: "private-markets" = specialist outlet (almost everything is relevant); "general-business" = stricter relevance filter.
priority: 1 = most authoritative. When several outlets cover a story, the lowest number becomes the lead link.
type "api" entries have no adapter yet and must stay disabled. language: two-letter code. pollEveryHours: 1-168. "_section" is a note for people and is ignored by the code.
